bounds.why: its own Vicat 170 °C + 5 °C: Vicat softening (a 10 N needle, 1 mm penetration) is reached at or above HDT at 0.45 MPa for an unfilled bar; the highest Vicat the material's own grades publish caps its unfilled heat deflection estimate softly (BVOH's estimate reached 158 °C against its own Vicat of 90 °C). No melting-point margin is applied below the melting point itself: PVDF publishes 158 °C, 12 °C under its melting point.

estimate.screenBasis: its bottom screens a maximum requirement: this-grade estimates, 1 of 48 true values lay below the plausible range; its bottom is taken at the 2.5% point so that at 90% confidence at most 10% of true values lie below it.
estimate.screenLimit: it cannot screen a minimum requirement: one of its own values (166 °C, converted to this property) lies above the range the model would screen on.
